name: Grade Building Co.
tagline: Additions, remodels, and new builds. Quoted plainly, built once.
service_area: Portland and the inner suburbs, within 30 miles
hours_note: Office open Mon–Fri, 7am–4pm. Site visits by appointment.

figures.label: Finished on the date we quoted

art_direction.identity: What's written on the materials of a job site: lumber grade stamps and surveyor's locate paint. Poured-concrete canvas, stamp-ink type, square corners, hairline rules, and bright daylight photographs of real work.
art_direction.type: Big Shoulders Stencil (weight 800, uppercase) for every heading, set huge and tight; Archivo for everything else at 1.0625rem/1.7. Never a third family.
art_direction.color: Canvas #e7e5e0, surface #f3f2ee, ink #17181a, muted #55565a, hairline #c9c6be. The locate-paint orange is bg-primary: CTA buttons, the paint swash, the quote band, list markers — a fill only, never text. Ink bands (bg-ink) for rhythm, one per page.
art_direction.signature: The grade stamp — an inked, double-ruled, slightly tilted tag pressed onto every project photo, logging the job name, year, scope, and weeks on site. Every photo of work gets one.
art_direction.voice: A site foreman who keeps promises. Short declarative sentences, real numbers, no exclamation points, no 'quality craftsmanship' filler.
